questions.question:
Assertion [A]: The Supreme Court of India in the S.R. Bommai vs Union of India case (1994) held that secularism is a basic feature of the Constitution and presidential proclamation under Article 356 is subject to judicial review.
Reason [R]: Judicial review of a proclamation under Article 356 allows courts to assess whether the exercise of power was based on relevant and bona fide material or vitiated by mala fides.
Select the correct answer:
options: Both [A] and [R] are true, and [R] is the correct explanation of [A]
Both [A] and [R] are true, but [R] is NOT the correct explanation of [A]
questions.explanation: In S.R. Bommai (1994), a 9-judge constitution bench laid down that presidential proclamations under Article 356 are subject to judicial scrutiny and secularism is inviolable.

questions.question:
Match List-I (Constitutional Amendments) with List-II (Key Subject Matters):
List-I:
(a) 42nd Amendment Act (1976)
(b) 44th Amendment Act (1978)
(c) 73rd Amendment Act (1992)
(d) 86th Amendment Act (2002)
List-II:
1. Right to Education inserted as Fundamental Right (Article 21A)
2. Deletion of Right to Property from Fundamental Rights and insertion of Article 300A
3. Constitutional status to Panchayati Raj Institutions via Part IX and 11th Schedule
4. Added 'Socialist, Secular, Integrity' to Preamble and Fundamental Duties in Part IVA
Select the correct answer using the codes given below:
(a) - (b) - (c) - (d)
questions.explanation: 42nd Amendment = Mini-constitution, added Preamble terms; 44th Amendment = Article 300A property right; 73rd = Panchayati Raj; 86th = Article 21A free education.
